verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a structured REST API reference covering types, paths and payloads for each operation, and many pages include request/response examples plus CLI, Terraform and SDK call snippets. No interactive try-it runner is documented, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec returned 404, so the examples are static snippets rather than runnable in-page calls. missing for 10: an interactive in-browser runner, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, examples on every page rather than many, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
